items.title: Segro agrees £14 billion takeover from US firm Prologis
items.summary: Segro had previously rebuffed three takeover offers from Prologis, with the most recent previous move worth about £13.5 billion.

items.title: Prologis Strikes Deal to Acquire Segro in £14.3 Billion Logistics Property Merger
items.summary: Prologis (NYSE:PLD) has reached an agreement to acquire Segro Plc (LSE:SGRO) in a transaction worth approximately £14. 3 billion, combining two of the world’s largest industrial property owners.

items.title: Prologis to Buy U.K.’s Segro for $18.8 Billion
items.summary: Segro’s directors intend to unanimously recommend the offer to shareholders who will be entitled to receive 0.0920 newly issued shares in Prologis for each Segro share held, with a partial cash alternative.

items.title: Public Storage Q2 FFO Misses on Same-Store NOI Decline, Revenues Beat
items.summary: PSA lags Q2 core FFO estimates, but higher revenues, acquisitions and a stronger 2026 outlook highlight how expansion is helping offset same-store pressure.

items.title: W.P. Carey's Q2 AFFO Beats Estimates on Investment Activity
items.summary: WPC tops Q2 AFFO estimates as investment activity and rent growth lift revenues. The company raises its 2026 AFFO guidance and investment outlook.
